★ FLAGSHIP · CIGNIFY · OCT 2026TEXT-TO-SQLCLAUDEBIGQUERYNODE / EXPRESS

ACC Direct API — Text-to-SQL you can trust in production

Ask a business question in plain English; get a correct, cost-controlled answer from BigQuery. The LLM proposes — deterministic code validates and executes. Nothing runs unguarded, and no number appears in the narrative unless it exists in the data.

Governed semantic layerYAML layer defining ~28 metrics — LTV, CAC, ROAS, cohort, repeat rate — mapped once to tables, columns and joins. Meaning is defined once, reused everywhere.
Validated, read-only executionSQL guard, 2 self-repair retries, and a narrative check that every figure in the answer exists in the result set.
Cost guards by designDry-run cost checks, maximumBytesBilled and daily token caps — so a bad question can never become a bad BigQuery bill.
Proven, not demoed35 tested saved queries plus a golden test harness. LTV, cohort, CAC, repeat rate, ROAS / CPA and attribution — all covered.

RAG Eval Lab · Build in Public

I scored 100%. Then I changed the questions.

My first eval set was too easy — every retriever looked perfect, so the test told me nothing. I rebuilt it harder: 90 questions, paraphrases, ambiguous questions, and control questions where the honest answer is “the document doesn't say.”

What the harder test showed

90 questions · 5 retrievers · one 3-document corpus

Cross-encoder rerank
94%
Hybrid (RRF)
82–90%
SBERT · BM25 · TF-IDF
below hybrid

Hybrid search landed between 82–90% depending on question type. Ambiguous questions were the hardest for every retriever — and one question beat all five, because the answer simply wasn't clear in the corpus. Full method and code are public on GitHub.

The lesson that changed how I build

My retriever was not the limit. My corpus was. A better model cannot fix missing, unclear content — so I measure retrieval before I trust it, in demos and in production.

Why this matters for product teams

Most RAG demos are graded on easy questions. Production users ask ambiguous ones. Eval design — hard questions, controls, abstention — is what separates a chatbot demo from an AI product.

Stack

Python · LangChain · sentence-transformers · scikit-learn · cross-encoder reranking · hybrid search (RRF).
